title: EESD verify-first (CORRECTED, full-scale device): semi-active MR control on the validated Ohtori benchmark
redo_reason: Prior attempt scaled a LAB-scale ~3 kN Spencer-Dyke 1996 device x7.08 to reach U_MAX and extrapolated its Bouc-Wen far outside calibration (realized force hit ~51x U_MAX) -- the force ceiling was a modeling convenience, not a datasheet. This redo uses a PUBLISHED full-scale device and lets its identified dynamics decide the ceiling (saturation = datasheet).

device.matching_statement: bank field-controllable force at I_MAX (N_DEV*alpha(I_MAX)*z_sat = 4.388e+05 N) and nominal rating (6.000e+05 N) bracket the active U_MAX (5.000e+05 N/floor); N_DEV=3 is the smallest honest bank reaching active authority (NO scaling, NO force clamp).

architecture: Yang-2002 full-scale 20-ton MR damper (modified Bouc-Wen, current-dependent alpha/c0/c1, exact identified params); N_DEV=3 per floor on a chevron brace (device deformation = interstory drift). Clipped-optimal (Dyke-Spencer 1996 / Jansen-Dyke 2000) primary from the same LQR as the active baselines; Lyapunov + passive-on cross-checks. SATURATION = current in [0, I_MAX=2A] through the device's own dynamics -- NO force clamp on the MR path; the active baselines keep their physical U_MAX clamp. Evaluated closed-loop on the full nonlinear OpenSees Ohtori plant (3-story primary, 9-story spot-check), FEMA P695 (atc63_norm*scale).
honesty_scope: Validated BILINEAR plant; drift/accel (J1-J6) ONLY -- not the trilinear MEX, not damage J7-J10. Matched authority via device rating (not a scale hack), real numbers, no cherry-picking. The device's uncontrollable viscous force c0(i)*v at high interstory velocity is reported, not hidden. 9-story uses the height-agnostic decentralized MR laws (the 3-DOF LQR gain is not height-valid), so the 9-story leg is MR-vs-uncontrolled.

field_control_value_vs_unpowered.interpretation: primary_minus_off_dJ < 0 => field control beats the unpowered passive hardware; ~0 or >0 => the controllable field force adds little/nothing and the reduction is essentially the device's intrinsic passive viscosity.

VERDICT: PARTIAL: MR robustly reduces response vs uncontrolled and is robust across records/heights, but does not cleanly dominate the active baselines on the matched-authority head-to-head. A reduction-vs-uncontrolled + deployability story may support A-modest; 'beats active' is not airtight -- see numbers.
